description: This file defines the TenantRazorCompiledItemLoader class, which loads RazorCompiledItem objects from an Assembly using reflection, allowing customization of how Razor view items are loaded and created.

classes.name: TenantRazorCompiledItemLoader
classes.description: A loader class that loads RazorCompiledItem objects from an Assembly using reflection, with methods to load attributes, create items, and load all items.

methods.name: LoadItems
methods.description: Loads a list of RazorCompiledItem objects from the specified Assembly.

methods.name: CreateItem
methods.description: Creates a RazorCompiledItem from a RazorCompiledItemAttribute, returning a specialized TenantRazorCompiledItem.

methods.name: LoadAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves RazorCompiledItemAttribute attributes from the given Assembly.
